units.source_text: 侍女们都看不起后来生的那个女公子，

en.t: The serving women all looked down on the young lady who had been born later,

units.source_text: 愤愤不平地说道：“哎呀！

en.t: and said resentfully, "Oh dear!

units.source_text: 出生的时辰多么不吉利啊！”

en.t: What an unlucky hour to have been born!"

units.source_text: 便不肯用心照管她。

en.t: So they refused to take proper care of her.

units.source_text: 但夫人临终之前，神志都已昏迷了的时候，

en.t: But before the lady died, when her mind had already grown clouded,

units.source_text: 还挂念这孩子，

en.t: she was still thinking anxiously of this child,

units.source_text: 对亲王的遗言只有一句话：

en.t: and she left the prince only one final request:

units.source_text: “请你当作我的遗念疼爱这孩子！”

en.t: "Please love this child as the keepsake I leave behind!"

units.source_text: 亲王认为：

en.t: The prince thought to himself:

units.source_text: 这孩子虽然由于前世命定，出生在这不祥的时刻，

en.t: Although this child, because of fate from a former life, was born at such an ominous hour,

units.source_text: 但对我亦必具有宿缘。

en.t: she must surely have some destined bond with me as well.

units.source_text: 况且夫人弥留之际还挂念她，

en.t: Besides, even as the lady lay dying, she was still concerned for her,

units.source_text: 嘱我好好照管呢。

en.t: and entrusted me to care for her well.

units.source_text: 这样一想，便非常疼爱这二女公子。

en.t: Thinking this, he came to love the second young lady very deeply.

units.source_text: 二女公子的相貌长得异常美丽，

en.t: The second young lady grew to be extraordinarily beautiful,

units.source_text: 竟使人疑心是异兆。

en.t: so much so that people wondered whether it was an uncanny omen.

units.source_text: 大女公子则性情娴静而沉着，

en.t: The elder young lady, by contrast, was gentle, quiet, and composed in nature,

units.source_text: 容貌举止大方而优雅，

en.t: and her looks and bearing were dignified and graceful,

units.source_text: 其高贵之相胜于乃妹。

en.t: with an air of nobility that surpassed her younger sister's.

units.source_text: 亲王认为两人各有所长，

en.t: The prince felt that each of the two had her own virtues,

units.source_text: 一样地疼爱。

en.t: and loved them equally.

units.source_text: 然而生涯轲，

en.t: Yet his life was beset with hardship,

units.source_text: 不能如意之事甚多。

en.t: and many things failed to go as he wished.

units.source_text: 年复一年，

en.t: Year after year passed,

units.source_text: 邸内日见萧条。

en.t: and the residence grew more desolate by the day.

units.source_text: 仆从等人看见主人已不可靠，

en.t: When the servants saw that their master could no longer be relied upon,

units.source_text: 不能忍受，

en.t: they found it impossible to endure,

units.source_text: 逐渐告辞散去。

en.t: and one by one they took their leave and drifted away.

units.source_text: 二女公子初生即遭母丧，

en.t: The second young lady lost her mother as soon as she was born,

units.source_text: 亲王在忙乱中未能替她仔细选择良好的乳母，

en.t: and in the confusion the prince was unable to choose a good wet nurse for her with care,

units.source_text: 只雇得一个教养粗浅的寻常妇女。

en.t: but could only hire an ordinary woman of shallow upbringing.

units.source_text: 在二女公子幼年时就辞去了她，

en.t: When the second young lady was still a small child, that woman left her service,

units.source_text: 故二女公子全由亲王自己一手抚育成长。

en.t: and so the second young lady was raised entirely by the prince himself.
